doneByClaude.headline: Fixed the Google Search Console "duplicate canonical" SEO error on lowendcandy.com
doneByClaude.summary: GSC flagged "Duplicate, Google chose different canonical than user." Root cause: the site is a client-rendered SPA that served the same index.html for every route with no <link rel="canonical">, so Google picked its own canonical. Fix is in draft PR #1 (branch claude/fix-this-liqgkq): new src/components/Seo.tsx writes a per-route self-referencing canonical + matching og:url and noindexes utility/404 pages; added a homepage canonical to index.html; added public/sitemap.xml plus a Sitemap: line in robots.txt. Production build passes and behavior was verified in a headless browser. PR: https://github.com/beaurmcleod/LEC/pull/1
